title: Worst habit tracker app I’ve seen
body:
So, the only pro I can see is the design. The app looks really pleasant. 

But the functions… most are useless, so little is made. 
I can’t see all of my habits at one place. (Well, in profile I can see a list, but I can’t do ANYTHING with it)
I can’t delete any habits except for the today’s ones. 
When I accidentally tap that I want to add something to my routine, I can’t delete it. 
I have to edit every habit manually, after browsing for it for ages. 

When you first see all the good-looking routines, you always add too many. But there is no convenient tool to edit that => even more procrastination. 

I don’t like paper planners, but they have much more options and scenarios than Me+. Regret every cent I’ve spent on the subscription.
author: Valeryia K

title: Alarm sounds 30 minutes before the time
